runs.t: •  Say: It's next to the store.

slides.notes:
Welcome. Say: "Today: places in town." Point to the map: "Bank. Pharmacy. Park. School."
Before class: print the Student Pages (number expected + 3 spares), one set of picture cards per group of 3–4, the map for Talk Time and Real-World Reading, and the left / right cards. Have the phone + small speaker and L1_L11_listening.mp3 ready. Prep time: 30 min.
Streets are invented (Main Street). Homework uses a map on paper or a phone; do not ask learners to walk alone.
Left / right: stand with the class, all facing the same way, before you mime.
Class plan: 6:00 Hello + Review, 6:10 New Words, 6:20 Listening, 6:32 Grammar, 6:45 Break, 7:00 Talk Time, 7:10 Exit Ticket + Homework, 7:15 Real-World Reading, 7:25 Progress Check.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (At a glance, Clock-time plan, Teacher notes).

slides.title: Around Town

runs.t: I can name places in town.
I can say next to, across from, between.
I can read a map and signs.

slides.notes:
Click to show each goal, one at a time. Read it aloud. Learners repeat.
Goal 1: places in town: bank, pharmacy, school, hospital, bus stop, store, park, restaurant, street, corner.
Goal 2: "Where's the bank?" "It's on Main Street."
Goal 3: "It's next to / across from / between…"
Goal 4: "Go straight. Turn left. Turn right." Understand a short directions dialogue.
Goal 5: read a simple map and street signs (EXIT, ONE WAY, PUSH) at 7:15.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (At a glance: Objectives).
slides.title: Today's Goals

runs.t: Is there a sofa in your home?

slides.notes:
Pairs. 15 learners: 7 pairs + 1 group of 3. 7–8 learners: 3–4 pairs. Late arrivals join any pair.
Before class, write on the board: Is there a kitchen? Where's the bank? Go straight.
Model with one learner: "Is there a kitchen?" "Yes, there is." Then mime: "Turn left."
Click to show the A question. Click again for the B answers. Pairs use the Hello + Review page: 1 Is there a kitchen in your home? 2 How many bedrooms are there? There are ___. 3 Is there a sofa in your home? Switch. Then find a new partner.
Homework check (last 3 min): partners show last week's homework. Walk around and look.
New learners: pair them with a strong partner. If behind: one partner only.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Step 1: Hello + Review; Student Pages: Hello + Review).

slides.title: Hello + Review

slides.notes:
Point to the places on the map: "Bank. Pharmacy. Park. School."
Click to show each picture. Point and say the word. Learners repeat 2 times. ★ words 2 more times.
★ = most important words (as on the New Words page). If behind: teach the ★ words only.

slides.notes:
Mime: "Go straight. Turn left. Turn right." Stand with the class, all facing the same way.
Click to show each picture. Say the word. Learners repeat 2 times.
Pairs (4 min): A points to a picture, B says the word. Then A asks "Where's the ___?" B answers with next to / across from.
★ = most important words. restaurant has no ★ on the New Words page. If behind: teach the ★ words only.

slides.title: More New Words

slides.notes:
Before you listen (1 min). Say: "Ana is on the street. She asks Marco for directions to the pharmacy."
Click to show each listen. Listen 1: Task A (circle: turn left or right, next to, across from). Listen 2: Task B (write the street name). Listen 3: Task C (check the directions you hear).
Say it!: read each line. Learners repeat: "Go straight two blocks." "It's next to the bank."
The audio L1_L11_listening.mp3 (about 1:10) plays the conversation once. Press play again for the next listen. Pairs compare after each task. Write answers on the board.
No speaker? Read the script with a volunteer. Streets are invented (Main Street).
Voices: Narrator, Ana, Marco. Synthetic voices made with Chatterbox TTS (MIT), copied from short reference clips made with Kokoro-82M (Apache 2.0); no recordings of real people.
If behind: play 2 times; do Task C together.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Step 3: Listening; Listening script).

slides.title: Before You Listen

slides.notes:
Listen 1 (Task A). Learners circle: 1 turn left or right; 2 the pharmacy is next to the bank or the school; 3 the pharmacy is across from the park or the hospital.
Pairs compare. Then click to show each answer: 1 left, 2 bank, 3 park.
In the audio: "Then turn left at the corner. It's next to the bank." "It's across from the park."
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Step 3: Listening; Student Pages: Listening A; Answer key; Listening script).
slides.title: Listening A

slides.notes:
Listen 2 (Task B): learners write the street name. Listen 3 (Task C): learners check the directions they hear.
Pairs compare. Then click to show each answer.
Task B: Main Street ("It's on Main Street.").
Task C: Go straight ✓ ("Go straight two blocks.") and Turn left ✓ ("Then turn left at the corner."). Turn right is not in the audio.
Also from the audio: the pharmacy is near the school (yes); the school is between the park and the store.
Say it with a partner (page D): "Excuse me. Where's the pharmacy?" "Go straight two blocks. Turn left. It's next to the bank." "Thank you!" "You're welcome."
If behind: play the audio 2 times, and do Task C together.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Step 3: Listening; Student Pages: Listening B, C, D; Answer key).
slides.title: Listening B + C

slides.notes:
Show the Grammar page. Left = question. Right = answer. Point left, then right.
Box 1: "Excuse me, where's the bank?" Click: "It's on Main Street." / "It's next to the pharmacy."
Box 2: "Where's the park?" Click: "It's across from the bank." "Where's the store?" Click: "It's between the bank and the school."
Use 3 learners or 3 chairs to show next to, across from, and between.
Where is or Where's? Both OK. Where's = Where is (fast speech).
Check question: "The pharmacy is ___ the bank." (next to)
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Step 4: Grammar Q&A, Boxes 1–2; Grammar Boxes 1 and 2; Questions and answers).

slides.title: Directions

runs.t: Go straight two blocks. Turn left.

slides.notes:
Box 4: "Excuse me. Where's the pharmacy?" Click: "It's on Main Street."
Right box: "How do I get there?" Click: "Go straight two blocks. Turn left."
Pairs: A asks, B is the helper. Then switch.
Pair drill (last 3–4 min): A asks Where's the…? B answers from the map; then A gives one direction. If behind: skip the pair drill; Talk Time practices the same language.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Step 4: Grammar Q&A, pair drill; Grammar Box 4).

slides.title: Grammar Box 4

slides.notes:
Box 5: read each DON'T SAY line. Shake your head. Click to show the SAY line. Learners repeat it.
It's near the school (not nearly). It's on Main Street (not in Main Street).
Side card: on or in the street? on Main Street. Turn left: no "to the". Where's = Where is.
Big mistake this week: in the left / mixing next to and across from. Mime and point.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Grammar Box 5; Questions and answers; Teacher notes).
slides.title: near / on the street

runs.t: Write: next to, across from, between, left, right.
Look at the map and Grammar Boxes 1–3.

slides.notes:
Learners write next to, across from, between, left, or right. Then pairs check.
Click to show each answer: 1 across from (next to is also OK), 2 across from, 3 between, 4 left, 5 left (right is also OK).
Line 6 on the page: learners write one direction (answers will vary).
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Grammar: Practice; Answer key: Grammar practice).
slides.title: next to, across from?

slides.notes:
Read each "Don't say" line. Shake your head. Click to show the correct line. Learners repeat it.
in Main Street → on Main Street. Turn to the left → Turn left. It's near of the bank → It's next to the bank.
Spanish speakers: Turn left (no "to the"); on Main Street (not in); next to = al lado de. Learners can read the Spanish note on their Grammar page.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Grammar: Common mistakes; Teacher notes).

slides.title: Directions

slides.notes:
Exit ticket (never skip): each learner says "Where's the ___?" or "Go straight / Turn left."
Homework (10 minutes): open the Homework page. Do item 1, line 1 together. Point to each instruction.
Homework: 1) write with next to, across from, or between; 2) write directions (2–3 short sentences); 3) look at a map (paper or phone) and write 3 places; do not walk alone for this homework; 4) ask a family member "Where's the store?" and write the answer in English if you can; 5) review: write There is… or There are… about your home (Lesson 10).

slides.title: Circle the Word

runs.t: c. It's next to the store.
b. It's across from the park.

slides.notes:
Progress Check (5 min). Individuals. Open the Progress Check page.
Part A: read each word slowly, 2 times: 1 bank, 2 left, 3 park, 4 pharmacy, 5 school. Learners circle.
Parts B and C: learners match and write on their own. Help with the instructions only. Click to show the Part B answers when you check together: 1 c, 2 d, 3 b, 4 a.
Part C answers: 1 across from, 2 between, 3 next to.
Part D: read each "I can…" line and point to the 3 faces. Learners check one.
Score: A /5 + B /4 + C /3 = /12. Not a test grade. Collect if you want. If behind: do it next week at 6:00.
Source: level1_curriculum/lesson11/Level1_Lesson11.md (Progress Check step; Student Pages: Progress Check; Answer key).
